        description :
        • The user and group mapping feature is currently in invitational preview. To use this feature, submit a ticket.
        • File system permission management in Apsara File Storage for HDFS relies on the users and groups of files. You must manage user and group mappings by calling API operations. For more information about the directory and file access permissions of Apsara File Storage for HDFS file systems, see Directory and file access permissions.
        • The number of users and groups in a single file system is subject to the following limits:
          • A single file system can have a maximum of 1,000 users.
          • A single file system can have a maximum of 30 groups.
          • Each user can belong to a maximum of 10 groups.

        description :

        The permission management of Apsara File Storage for HDFS file systems relies on file users and groups. You must manage user and group mappings by calling API operations. For more information about directory and file access permissions in Apsara File Storage for HDFS, see Directory and file access permissions. The number of users and groups in a single file system is subject to the following limits:

        • A single file system supports up to 1,000 users.
        • A single file system supports up to 30 groups.
        • Each user can belong to up to 10 groups.
        summary :

        Queries the user and group mappings of an Apsara File Storage for HDFS file system instance.
